units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. The walk keeps the published version; it has no H3 take. The attack was retaken with room above, because the first smash cut the hammer at the top edge, and with steady light. The cast was retaken as a single war cry, because the first take raised the hammer twice and strobed dark. The hit recovers before its dark plates. The defend ends on the raised hammer guard before a second, lower crouch. Idle, hit, defend and death are first takes.
